Economy & Markets.title: Will no Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: 88% odds of a rate cut. Lower rates reduce operating loan and land interest carrying cost -- historically supportive of commodity prices via weaker dollar.

Economy & Markets.title: Fed rate hike in 2026?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: 66% odds of a rate hike. Tighter policy strengthens the dollar and pressures grain export competitiveness.

Economy & Markets.title: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the September 2026 meeting?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: Fed policy moves ripple through the dollar and farm lending -- 40% YES on this outcome.

Economy & Markets.title: Will the Fed decrease interest rates by 25 bps after the September 2026 meeting?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: Fed policy moves ripple through the dollar and farm lending -- 2% YES on this outcome.

Trade & Policy.title: Will China's annual inflation in 2026 be between 1.1% and 1.5%?
Trade & Policy.why_it_matters: China is the world's largest soybean buyer -- any policy shift moves US ag exports.
